Government of India
Ministry of Law & Justice
Department of Justice

Jaisalmer House, 26, Man Singh Road,
New Delhi-110 011, Dated: 14th July, 2025.

NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the power conferred by clause (1) of Article 222 of the Constitution of India, the President, after consultation with the Chief Justice of India, is pleased to transfer Shri Justice Aparesh Kumar Singh, Chief Justice of the Tripura High Court, to be Chief Justice of the Telangana High Court and direct him to assume charge of his office in the Telangana High Court.

(Jagannath/Srinivasan)
Joint Secretary to the Government of India
Tele: 2338 3037

To

The Manager,
